__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="what-is-prayer-flicking" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>What is Prayer Flicking?</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Prayer flicking is often thought of as two separate things:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>1) ‘Prayer flicking’</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Prayer flicking is changing your protection prayer to that of the boss’s current attacks (and changing the protection prayer as they change styles).This can be done </nowiki><em><nowiki>on either</nowiki></em><nowiki> prayer book.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On the standard prayer book (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommelee" title="protectfrommelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551456835768351.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommagic" title="protectfrommagic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551455078367313.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommissiles" title="protectfrommissiles" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941136397324448.png?v=1" alt="protectfromnecro" title="protectfromnecro" kind="icon" /><nowiki>), requiring up to 46 Prayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ‎ ‎to protect from all 4 styles.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• With curses (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="deflectrange" title="deflectrange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809111178813471.png?v=1" alt="deflectnecromancy" title="deflectnecromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>), requiring up to 73 Prayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to protect from all 4 styles.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>2) ‘Soul Split flicking’</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Soul split flicking means using the Soul Split prayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> most of the time, and then switching back to the protection prayer for the boss’s current attack style before the boss’s attack hits.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Soul Split flicking can </nowiki><em><nowiki>only</nowiki></em><nowiki> be done with curses, requiring 92 Prayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to have access to Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and the 4 protection prayers </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="deflectrange" title="deflectrange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809111178813471.png?v=1" alt="deflectnecromancy" title="deflectnecromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This guide will cover the benefits of both prayer and Soul Split flicking, and explain how to do them!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="why-is-prayer-flicking-useful"><ins><nowiki>Why is Prayer Flicking Useful?</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="damage-reduction"><nowiki>Damage Reduction</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Having a protection prayer up reduces your incoming damage from this style by 50%.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Increased to 60% reduction if wearing an Amulet of Souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1" alt="aos" title="aos" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or an Essence of Finality amulet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The same +10% damage reduction can be gained from powder of protection </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1" alt="powderofprotection" title="powderofprotection" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if they are not wearing the amulets mentioned above. Powder and amulet effect do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> stack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Keeping the correct protection prayer up even when the boss is changing attack styles reduces the damage taken substantially.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This reduces food usage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When the correct prayer is active, the Devotion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ability, as well the Devoted </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1" alt="dev4" title="dev4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Enhanced Devoted </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1" alt="enhdev4" title="enhdev4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> perk effects can be used to block 100% of the typed damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="why-is-soul-split-flicking-useful"><ins><nowiki>Why is Soul Split Flicking Useful?</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="extra-healing"><nowiki>Extra Healing</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Having Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> active for most of the time you are attacking results in a lot of extra healing.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This extra healing can reduce the food needed for bosses substantially, and can even remove the need to use food entirely.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When wearing an Amulet of Souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1" alt="aos" title="aos" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or an Essence of Finality amulet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Soul Split has a 50% chance to heal 25-50% more for a total average of 18.75% more healing.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="soul-split-synergy"><nowiki>Soul Split Synergy</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required for the ECB special attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Necromancy Split Soul incantation </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1" alt="splitsoul" title="splitsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to work</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> flicking makes it safer and more feasible to make use of these, as you still get the benefit from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, but now have the heavy damage reduction of protection prayers.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="why-is-reducing-food-usage-good"><ins><nowiki>Why is Reducing Food Usage Good?</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general-benefits"><nowiki>General Benefits</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Can increase room for error which makes kills more comfortable.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Increases kills per trip at bosses you do not want to teleport out of.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Reduces the supply cost for bossing.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="reduces-drawback-of-solids-and-saradomin-brews"><nowiki>Reduces Drawback of Solids and Saradomin Brews</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using solid food (e.g. sailfish </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489363087360.png?v=1" alt="sailfish" title="sailfish" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) drains adrenaline and using Saradomin brews </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489400573962.png?v=1" alt="brew" title="brew" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reduces stats</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Reducing the need to use them reduces the amount of adrenaline lost or stats drained throughout the course of a fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="allows-you-to-comfortably-swap-from-beast-of-burden-bob-to-dps-familiar"><nowiki>Allows You to Comfortably Swap from Beast of Burden (BoB) to DPS Familiar</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You may have been using a BoB </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513195712201228289.png?v=1" alt="yak" title="yak" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1499293961364308059.png?v=1" alt="mammothpouch" title="mammothpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to bring more food to an encounter</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Reducing food means less need for a BoB, allowing the use of a DPS familiar </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1" alt="smokenihil" title="smokenihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1" alt="kalgpouch" title="kalgpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> which further reduces kill times which further reduces food usage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="how-to-prayer-soul-split-flick"><ins><nowiki>How to Prayer / Soul Split Flick?</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="advice"><nowiki>Advice</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The most important step towards prayer or Soul Split flicking is setting up good keybinds (see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#interface-guide</nowiki></span><nowiki>) and using them lots to build up muscle memory.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Most people have these close together on the keyboard, near their abilities so that they can be used throughout the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="the-method"><nowiki>The Method</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>1) Look at the boss’s attack animations for the style.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>2) Look at the boss’s attack rotation for attack styles (e.g. in the second phase of Vindicta </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949385445376.png?v=1" alt="vindicta" title="vindicta" kind="icon" /><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>3) When an attack animation of a style you are not currently protecting against happens, switch to that protection prayer.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/6hMspYdCZT.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>4) If Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> flicking, switch back to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after taking the reduced damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/euhEn55jpv.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: if Soul Split flicking, you want to switch from Soul Split to the protection prayer as </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>late</nowiki></em><em><nowiki> as possible to have Soul Split active for as long as possible, so it is good to get used to the timing of the hits to make the most out of your Soul Split time.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="good-places-to-practice-prayer-soul-split-flicking"><ins><nowiki>Good Places to Practice Prayer / Soul Split Flicking</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Arch Glacor </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/891948878583189514.png?v=1" alt="archglacor" title="archglacor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> normal mode with the flurry attack toggled on.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vindicta </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949385445376.png?v=1" alt="vindicta" title="vindicta" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2nd phase has an attack rotation of charge → melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit → ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit → melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Araxxor </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213019543699466.png?v=1" alt="araxxi" title="araxxi" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is slightly harder if using melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and not standing at halberd range, as you have less time to react to its melee attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Raksha </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/789813907706478603.png?v=1" alt="raksha" title="raksha" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Jad (Fight Caves, Kiln, or within Zuk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/931175752651653121.png?v=1" alt="tzkalzuk" title="tzkalzuk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> encounter)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Any other boss you want to do!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="tips-to-help-learning-to-prayer-soul-split-flick"><ins><nowiki>Tips to Help Learning to Prayer / Soul Split Flick</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> be discouraged if you feel you are missing a lot of prayer flicks - it is not uncommon. These skills are very rewarding, and near </nowiki><strong><nowiki>essential</nowiki></strong><nowiki> for pvm at stronger bosses, so worth learning sooner rather than later. Adding in Soul Split can come at a later stage once you're comfortable with flicking the protection prayers.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you find yourself a little bit overwhelmed with the new keybinds, its not a bad idea to set up revo or revo++ to reduce your inputs as you start learning, and then later going back to either revo or full manual when you are more comfortable.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you have learnt how to prayer flick, don’t be scared to give Soul Split flicking a go, even if just at bosses which attack a little bit slower.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="examples"><ins><nowiki>Examples</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Examples</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Some examples of good prayer flicking.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
